data.action: 蜷成一团，尾巴盖在身上
data.description: 【铃兰 · 窝里夜话】夜晚温馨的宿舍小床上，丽萨整个人像只可爱的小狐狸一样蜷缩成一团，九条蓬松厚实的大尾巴把身体团团包裹起来当做最温暖的被子。她露出小脑袋向你眨巴着大眼睛——「博士，九尾的毛皮超级暖和哦！今晚想听博士讲睡前故事再睡觉……」
data.promptProse: Suzuran curls on her dorm bed in fluffy pastel pajamas, her nine thick golden tails wrapped around her like a blanket. Only her head peeks above the fur as she looks toward the viewer for a bedtime story. The medium close-up holds pillows behind her head and bedding underneath. A dim bedside lamp warms the nearest tails, with layered shadows where their curls overlap.
data.title: 铃兰 · 窝里夜话
